## Problem and source evidence

Link the observed behavior, fixture or user feedback. Distinguish observed defects from proposed improvements.

## Intended user outcome

What becomes easier, more reliable or more useful?

## Scope

Describe the smallest change. Record deferred ideas and affected contracts.

## Acceptance checks

- [ ] Correctness case and at least one meaningful failure/edge case
- [ ] Relevant type/build/test checks on exact commit
- [ ] User-facing behavior reviewed where applicable
- [ ] Documentation/status reflects observed behavior

## Dependencies and decisions

Backlog ID, milestone, decision IDs and required external configuration. Include only relevant constraints.

## Verification record

Base/target SHA; environment; commands/fixtures; passed/failed/blocked; limitations; preview URL only if actually created and appropriate to share.
